title: Navimower 0.4.1-beta10

## Hint-error payload decoding diagnostics

This beta investigates `/vehicle/vehicle/get-hint-error-compress` while keeping beta9 problem-state behavior unchanged.

- Preserve and safely inspect the large hint/error response instead of reducing it to only a length/hash summary.
- Detect plain JSON/text, Base64/URL-safe Base64 and hex wrapping, then gzip, zlib, bzip2, xz and Zstandard compression where a decoder is available.
- Export decode-layer lengths/hashes, decoded magic bytes, code candidates and bounded error/fault-related text. Decoded JSON still passes through the existing diagnostics sanitization/redaction.
- Apply hard input and decompression limits so an unknown or malformed payload cannot grow diagnostics without bounds.
- **Problem** and **Error** entity semantics are intentionally unchanged; field testing comes first.

Compare diagnostics captured during an active problem such as Lifted with a later normal/cleared state.
